page.overview:
Who is Collared Aracari?

The (Pteroglossus torquatus) also known as moku-pa or mokú-pá (meaning "owl parrot" in the Bribri language by the Tun-Si tribe), is a species of toucan that is native to tropical forests from Mexico to Colombia and Venezuela.

The moku-pa appears multiple times in Jurassic Park: The Game.
